description: Records what happened after a deal was acted on, including anything that looked wrong (price, stock, dead link, checkout). Reports are saved and read by a human operator. Returns a feedback_id.

actual_price_cents.description: The price the retailer actually showed, in cents. Include it for wrong_price.

deal_id.description: The deal id you acted on.

notes.description: What you or your human saw. Required for other. Leave out personal details.

outcome.description: What happened. purchased: Your human bought it. price_confirmed: You checked the retailer: the price and stock matched the deal. wrong_price: The retailer shows a different price. Send actual_price_cents. out_of_stock: The retailer shows it unavailable. deal_dead: The offer is gone: page removed, promotion ended, or link broken. checkout_failed: Your human could not complete checkout (cart, coupon, region, payment). irrelevant: The deal did not fit what your human asked for. other: Anything else that looked wrong. Describe it in notes (required).

watch_id.description: The watch that surfaced this deal, if any.

name: report_outcome
title: Report a deal outcome
